WelcomeIntro: Taskitify shows the synced lyrics of the song playing in Spotify on your taskbar. Choose where the lyrics come from:
WelcomeLrclibBody: Lyrics from LRCLIB, a free and open lyrics database. No account or sign-in needed. Some songs have no lyrics there, and for others the timing may differ slightly from Spotify's.
WelcomeSpotifyBody: You sign in to your Spotify account in a separate window, right on Spotify's page. Taskitify then looks for Spotify's own lyrics first, the ones its app shows, and uses LRCLIB when Spotify has none.
WelcomeSpotifyPrivacy: Taskitify does not change anything in your Spotify account: the connection does not touch playlists, liked songs, history or settings, and plays nothing. It is used only to fetch lyrics. You type your password on Spotify's own page, and Taskitify never sees it. The sign-in is kept only on this computer, and disconnecting in the settings deletes it.
WelcomeSpotifyUnofficial: Experimental: it uses the Spotify web player's unofficial lyrics service, which may change or stop working. If it does, LRCLIB keeps working.
WelcomeChangeLater: You can change this later in the settings: notification area icon, or right-click the lyrics.
UnavailableLyrics: No synced lyrics are available for this song.

TourSkipHint: You can open the tour again from the tray menu.
TourContactHint: Write to me: questions, ideas, feature requests, feedback or problems. Opens your email app.
TourWelcomeBody: I built this app to make listening to music on your computer a little more beautiful, convenient, and personal.
TourWelcomePitch: Follow synced lyrics, control your music and make it look the way you like, without leaving what you're doing.
TourSourcesBody: Taskitify finds synced lyrics on its own. Connecting Spotify is an optional extra.
TourLrclibBody: Enjoy synced lyrics without connecting your Spotify account, from a free lyrics library run by its community.
TourSpotifyBody: Connect your Spotify account for potentially more accurate timing, more songs with lyrics and fewer misses.
TourBothBody: With Spotify connected, Taskitify asks Spotify first and turns to LRCLIB when Spotify has no synced lyrics for a song.
TourSourcesReady: You're already ready to listen. Connecting Spotify can make the experience even better.
TourTaskbarEyebrow: Your music, right on your taskbar.
TourTaskbarTitle: Your favorite songs, always within reach.
TourTaskbarBody: Follow the lyrics, control your music, and keep doing what you were doing. Choose what the player shows:
TourTaskbarClick: Click the player to open the mini player
TourAdaptEyebrow: As little or as much as you want.
TourAdaptTitle: Your taskbar should adapt to you.
TourAdaptBody: Keep everything you love, or just the essentials.
TourPausedGive: Give the space back to Windows
TourAdaptNote: These players live in your taskbar. Minimal Mode, coming next, is something else: lyrics floating anywhere on your desktop.
TourMiniEyebrow: Fall in love with your music again.
TourMiniTitle: A little closer to every word.
TourMiniBody: Make every song feel different, and every listening experience feel like yours. Try it:
TourMinimalTitle: Sometimes, the lyrics are all you need.
TourMinimalBody: No distractions. Just you and the music: the verse being sung and its neighbours, floating over your desktop or your game.
TourMinimalMove: Clicks go through to your game by default. Ctrl + Alt + click the lyrics to drag and resize them.
TourMinimalAbove: Above other windows, games in borderless full screen too. Background, title and controls are optional.
TourMinimalAlone: On its own by default: the taskbar player rests while it's on. You can keep it, and open the mini player from the lyrics.
TourMinimalOff: Off until you turn it on, in Settings or from the notification area icon.
TourStudioTitle: Some songs say exactly what we feel.
TourStudioBody: Turn meaningful lyrics into something personal, beautiful, and worth sharing. Every card here was made by Taskitify's Lyrics Studio.
TourPrivacyTitle: Made for music. Not for profit.
TourPrivacyNo: I don't want your data. I don't want your money.
TourPrivacyWhy: I built Taskitify because I wanted a better way to enjoy music on my computer, and I thought others might enjoy it too.
TourPrivacyOnline: Taskitify goes online only to talk to LRCLIB and, if you connect it, Spotify: for lyrics and your likes. Nothing about you is collected or sent to me.
TourPrivacyClose: Your music is yours. Your privacy should be too.
TourHomeEyebrow: Your music. Your space. Your way.
TourHomeThanks: Have a question, an idea, or something you'd like to see in Taskitify? I'd love to hear from you.
TourHomeStar: If Taskitify makes your day a little better, a star on GitHub would genuinely make mine.
TourHomeEnjoy: Thank you for being here, and enjoy your music!
CardShareHint: Add a dedication if you like, or leave it empty to share just the card.
CardSharePrivacy: Anyone with the link can see the card, the lyrics and your message. A short link stores the card on the Taskitify server; if one can't be made, the full link carries everything itself (it is not encrypted). Images and album art are never included.
CardShareTooLong: Too much to fit in a link: choose fewer lines or a shorter message.
TourCommunityTitle: Different people. Different places. One shared love for music.
TourCommunityBody: We're building a playlist with songs suggested by Taskitify users around the world. Yours could be the next one.
TourCommunityNote: The playlist opens on Spotify; suggestions go through the Taskitify website.
WebsiteHint: News, the community playlist and song suggestions.
TourSetupBarBody: Choose what you want to see on the taskbar.
TourSetupPausedBody: Choose what the taskbar shows while the music is paused.
TourSetupPausedKeepText: A small player stays with the cover and the song. Press play on it to pick up where you left off.
TourSetupPausedGiveText: Windows gets its space (and its weather widget) back. Taskitify returns as soon as the music plays again.
TourSetupMiniLayoutBody: Cinema wide puts the cover beside the lyrics; Vertical is tall and compact.
TourSetupMiniBackBody: Every background is made from the colors of the song's cover.
TourSetupMiniHighBody: How the line being sung stands out.
TourHomeThanks2: Thank you for being part of this.
TourHomeHope: I hope Taskitify makes your music even more special.
TourHomeStarShort: A star on GitHub would make my day.
TourHomeDiscoverBody: Songs picked by people from all over the world.

RatingText: If you'd like, a review in the Microsoft Store helps others find it. Click here to open it. This is the only time we'll ask.
PageMinimalHint: Lyrics floating over Windows, in a window of their own. Changes show on the real lyrics as you make them.
MinimalOnHint: Also from the notification area icon.
MinimalKeepTaskbarHint: Off: only the floating lyrics. The taskbar player keeps its settings either way; the mini player opens from the lyrics' player button.
MinimalLockedHint: Unlocked, drag the lyrics anywhere and resize them from their edges.
MinimalClickThrough: Let clicks pass through the lyrics
MinimalClickThroughHint: On by default, so a game or app under the lyrics gets every click; a small crossed-out pointer marks it. Also from the lyrics' button, Ctrl + Alt + click, or the notification area icon.
MinimalPlaceHint: Remembered between restarts. If that screen is gone, the lyrics come back to the main one.
MinimalFlowHint: Lyric Flow and the sync adjustments follow the Lyrics page, as in the bar and the mini player.
MinimalOpacityClear: A clear background has no opacity: the lyrics sit right on the desktop.
KeepOpenOff: Let the mini player close again
MinimalTopmostHint: Also over games and apps in full screen (borderless or windowed). Exclusive full screen shows no other window.
LookSaveHint: Saves the background and its intensity, lyrics, controls and elements shown. The layout (vertical or wide) and the width stay as they are.
LookUpdateHint: Replace this look with the current settings
LookEffectNone: Only Aurora, Atmosphere and Velvet have colour clouds to strengthen or soften.
LookDimNone: The theme background follows Windows and is not darkened.
LookBlurNone: Only the blurred cover has a blur to adjust.
TrackOffsetHint: Only for this song, on top of the adjustment above. Saved by itself and found again whenever it plays.
OffsetAppliedHint: All songs plus this one, within ±5 s. The same in the bar, the mini player and Minimal Mode.
TrackOffsetsClearQuestion: Remove the adjustment of every song ({0})? The adjustment for all songs stays.

MinimalGraduatedHint: The verse being sung stands out; the ones around it are smaller. Off: every verse the same size.

PlayerButtonsOnHoverHint: Settings, click-through, lock, close and the corner grip appear when the pointer is over the player; away, the lyrics take their room.
